$comment: Consumers of this package's MCP surface, for the release wave (mnemoverse-agent-pack protocols/surface-contour.md; registry skills/release-wave/references/surfaces.yaml). release.yml opens a 'Wave vX.Y.Z' issue with one checklist line per entry; scripts/check-release-sync.mjs probes every non-manual entry daily and ticks the line. `kind`: auto (updates without a person), track (a person merges, the probe proves it), manual (no live probe; a person ticks the line). `fix` may use <version>. Add a consumer here and in surfaces.yaml in the same change.

consumers.name: docs site (llms-full.txt)
consumers.fix: merge the bump PR that mcp-version-watch.yml (in mnemoverse-docs) opens from branch bot/mcp-version-<version>, or, if the bot could not open it, open one by hand from that branch.

consumers.name: marketing site (server-card.json)
consumers.fix: until the static card becomes a redirect to the connector's live card (mnemoverse-workspace#30 S5): merge a "chore(mcp): version stamps" PR in mnemoverse-marketing that sets serverInfo.version to <version> in public/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json.

consumers.name: hosted connector (/health package.version)
consumers.fix: merge the pin bump in mnemoverse-mcp-remote (the Dependabot PR or the receiver's PR) and let Railway deploy it; the package field appears once step 4 PR 4 (observability) is deployed.

consumers.name: @mnemoverse/ai-sdk (pin; private repository, no public probe)
consumers.fix: its surface-bump.yml contour runs on the dispatch from release.yml and every 6 h; confirm in that repository that the pin is <version> (and, once it is published, that npm serves the matching surface).

consumers.name: VS Code extension README and SKILL.md (tool list)
consumers.fix: the runtime spawns npx @latest and needs nothing; if the release changed the tool set, update the tool list in README.md and skills/mnemoverse-memory/SKILL.md (or replace it with a link, mnemoverse-workspace#30 S7).

consumers.name: plugin READMEs (claude-plugin, cursor-plugin, gemini-extension)
consumers.fix: if the release changed the tool set, update the lists in the three READMEs (or replace them with a link, mnemoverse-workspace#30 S7).

consumers.name: catalog submissions (Claude connectors directory, Cursor Marketplace, Smithery, ChatGPT)
consumers.fix: the Official MCP Registry, Glama and PulseMCP ingest automatically; for the form-based catalogs check the ledger in mnemoverse-distribution/STATUS.md and resubmit if the version or the tool list they show is behind <version>.
